bio: The pleasant, rustic-style alternative to Bembergs Häuschen has a distinctly cosy feel. The menu features mouthwatering regional classics such as roast Eifel beef with roast potatoes, as well as internationally influenced dishes such as cod with a lemon crunch topping and Chinese cabbage. There are also daily changing specials. The two chandeliers fashioned from bottles are sure to draw the eye! The view through the windowed façade onto the pond is also lovely....
